summary: Initializes locale-matching state and dispatches a system-wide locale enumeration. Marks dword_8D3FA4 when the language string at dword_8D3FA8 has length 3 and dword_8D3F9C when the region string at dword_8D3FAC has length 3 (via Strlen 0058E1B0). Resets Locale (0x008D3F98) to 0, sets charset mode dword_8D3FA0 to 2 for a 3-letter language or to CountAlphabeticalChars (00590616) otherwise, then calls EnumSystemLocalesA with LocaleEnumProc (0x0058FFEC). After enumeration, validates dword_8D3FB0 flags (0x100, 0x200, 0x7) and clears it to 0 on failure. Called by sub_58FD90 (0058FD90).

operations.description: Strlen (0058E1B0) is called on the language string at dword_8D3FA8; equality with length 3 is stored to dword_8D3FA4
Strlen (0058E1B0) is called on the region string at dword_8D3FAC; equality with length 3 is stored to dword_8D3F9C
Clears the current locale global Locale (0x008D3F98) to 0 before enumeration
When the language is a 3-letter code (dword_8D3FA4 set), charset mode dword_8D3FA0 is set to 2; otherwise it is set to the CountAlphabeticalChars (00590616) result over dword_8D3FA8
EnumSystemLocalesA (0x0059E138) is invoked with LocaleEnumProc (0x0058FFEC) as callback and 1 (LOCALE_SORT_DEFAULT style) to enumerate system locales
Captures dword_8D3FB0 as the return value; the post-enumeration callback may have populated it
If dword_8D3FB0 lacks any of the 0x100, 0x200 or 0x7 flag bits, it is reset to 0; the captured pre-reset value is still returned
Returns the pre-validation snapshot of dword_8D3FB0 regardless of whether the guard cleared it
